recordedRisks.risk: pouchdb-authentication may imply a CouchDB remote on the login path
recordedRisks.finding: Examined directly in the reconciled source. src/shared/config/pouchdb.ts registers pouchdb-authentication as a PouchDB plugin, but it only constructs a server database when process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' (an in-memory adapter). In every non-test build `serverDb` is left undefined and the module still exports `export const remoteDb = serverDb as PouchDB.Database`. The four call sites — App.tsx `remoteDb.getSession()` on mount and user-slice.ts `logIn`, `getUser`, `logOut` — therefore dereference `undefined` at runtime rather than contacting a remote. App.tsx wraps the mount-time call in try/catch and only `console.log`s the failure before rendering, and no /login route is declared in the router at all.
recordedRisks.consequence: No CouchDB host is contacted by a normal dev or production build at this revision. Local-only operation is what the code does, and the persistent store is the browser-default PouchDB adapter on the database named `local_hospitalrun` (constructed with skip_setup).
recordedRisks.residual: `.env.example` declares REACT_APP_HOSPITALRUN_API=http://localhost:5984 and docker-compose.yml provisions a CouchDB with a hard-coded development admin password. Neither is referenced from src or public — REACT_APP_HOSPITALRUN_API appears nowhere in the application code — so both read as vestigial at this revision. The docker-compose credentials were not copied into any Versionless artifact and must not be.
recordedRisks.state: resolved-by-reading-the-code; local-only operation confirmed at the source level, not at the browser level

recordedRisks.finding: The pinned revision is 2.0.0-alpha.7 of a 2.0 rewrite, and the upstream repository is now archived. The CHANGELOG shows an active alpha series around this date.
recordedRisks.consequence: Behaviour, route stability, and completeness are what an alpha carries. This is recorded, not discounted.

recordedRisks.risk: i18n translation:check gate in the start script
recordedRisks.finding: `start` and `test` are prefixed with `npm run translation:check`, which compiles scripts/check-translations/index.ts with tsc and runs the emitted JavaScript, bracketed by pre/post rimraf steps. `build` is NOT gated: it is plain `react-scripts build`.
recordedRisks.consequence: Any later unit that drives the dev server through `npm start` inherits this gate; a unit that only builds does not.
recordedRisks.state: recorded; the gate was not exercised in this unit

recordedRisks.risk: no lockfile is committed at the pinned revision
recordedRisks.finding: The recursive tree at the pinned revision contains no package-lock.json, no yarn.lock, and no npm-shrinkwrap.json. Dependency ranges are tilde/caret ranges, and .npmrc sets save-prefix='~'.
recordedRisks.consequence: The dependency closure is not pinned by the repository. A baseline install today resolves ranges against the registry as it exists today, and the resolution drifted far enough to break the build — see baseline-attempt.json.
recordedRisks.state: recorded; this is the dominant reproducibility risk for this fixture
